title: Amni-CAD — Engineering-Guided AI Design
excerpt: AI designs the part, your engineers and drafters sign off. Guided steps, auto-drafted drawings, stress and flow checks, and one-step import from your old PDM or paper drawings, in the browser.
content_html:
AMNI-SCIENT

ENGINEERING-GUIDED AI DESIGN • IN YOUR BROWSER • FREE TO START

DesignTestQuoteSheet metalMakeAI co-designBuildVaultPricing

DESIGN

Parametric parts, organic shapes, and drawings drafted for you.

TEST

Stress and airflow, solved on your own computer.

QUOTE

A shop price for every process while you design, plus an overseas online estimate for CNC parts.

SHEET METAL

Flanges, returns, hems and Z bends. Unfold to a flat DXF with bend lines, a bend table and press brake force.

MAKE

Toolpaths, G-code, setup sheets and flat DXF. CAM is in beta.

AI CO-DESIGN

Ask in plain words. The AI builds the part, checks its own work and runs the study. You approve every change.

BUILD

Put parts together into assemblies, with a bill of materials.

VAULT

Move in from your old PDM or a drawer of paper drawings. Scans are redrawn as clean vector drawings, and each part is rebuilt in 3D from its views.

Secure checkout by Stripe. Cancel subscriptions anytime. Any payment is refunded in full if you ask within 14 days. Need an invoice or purchase order? Contact us.

CTE and trade schools: a seat or site license covers Amni-CAD and Amni-Construct for class and shop work. It is quoted. Email sales@amni-scient.com. That is separate from the $5 student plan, which is one person.

Do my designs leave my computer?

No. Geometry, simulations and drawings are computed in your browser, and designs are saved only there or in files you download. There is no account for the free tier and no activity logging. Read exactly what the optional cloud features send.

Which CAD programs can I exchange files with?

Any program that reads STEP: SOLIDWORKS, Inventor, Fusion, Creo, NX, CATIA, Solid Edge, Onshape and FreeCAD. Drawings export as PDF, SVG and DXF, and meshes as STL, 3MF, OBJ, glTF and PLY.

Does it work offline?

Yes. License keys are checked on your device. For a machine that is never online, contact us about a fixed-term or perpetual key.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes, from Pro → Manage billing in Amni-CAD. Your key works to the end of the paid period, then everything in Free keeps working.

Can I get a refund?

Yes. Email billing@amni-scient.com within 14 days of a payment, monthly, yearly or Lifetime, and we refund it in full. The refund ends what that payment bought (Terms G12).

Can a trade school or CTE program license this?

Yes. A seat is one instructor or one lab computer. A site license covers the students and instructors in a program, on school machines, for class and shop work, not for paid commercial jobs. Amni-Construct is on the same quote. Email sales@amni-scient.com. Details are on the school license page.

MORE

Last updated November 3, 2026
